title: Unified Investigation Object — Canonical Schema
purpose: Define the single canonical JSON object that represents a question with all administrative metadata — the complete view an investigator needs to understand any question's state, history, defects, challenges, recommendations, and resolution path.
authority: Derived from real field names in question_history.json, investigation_registry.json, challenge_registry.json, challenge_triage.json, recommendation_registry.json, session_registry.json, question_health.json, and pack_*_corrected.js.

unifiedInvestigationObject.description: Complete administrative view of a single CMA Part 1 question. Every field and sub-object has a defined data source (registry file or engine API). FK references are strings that resolve within their respective registries.

question.description: Top-level question identity and state. Source: question_history.json + pack file.
question.pack: string — pack_a | pack_b | pack_c | pack_d | pack_e
question.section: string — A | B | C | D | E | F
question.sectionName: string — e.g. External Financial Reporting Decisions
question.topic: string — e.g. A.001 balance sheet current classification
question.cognitiveLevel: string — Remember | Understand | Apply | Analyze | Evaluate
question.difficulty: string — Easy | Moderate | Difficult | Very Difficult
question.currentState: string — Certified | In Audit | Unprocessed | Archived

content.description: Full question content. Source: pack_*_corrected.js (authoritative for CC, EC, EW, Stem, Choices).
content.losTag: string | null — e.g. A.1 Financial statements

health.healthTier: string — HEALTHY | FAIR | NEEDS ATTENTION | CRITICAL

componentScores.structural: integer 0-100 — penalty from structural flags (DL-008, DL-026, EV3, etc.)

health.diagnosis: string — human-readable summary of health factors
structuralFlags: string — e.g. DL-026: FAIL — 2 empty EW slots

items.status: string — OPEN | INVESTIGATING | RESOLVED | CLOSED | DISMISSED
string — OPEN | INVESTIGATING | ACTION_REQUIRED | RESOLVED | CLOSED

resolution.resolution_type: string | null — CONFIRMED_DEFECT | CONFIRMED_VALID | DUPLICATE | etc.

readiness.description: Operational readiness assessment. Source: readiness_scoring.json, QUALITY_VERDICT.json.
blockingDefects: string — active DL codes preventing certification

outcome.description: Synthesized view combining current_state, health tier, defect status, and readiness into a single administrative verdict.
outcome.currentState: string — Certified | In Audit | Unprocessed | Archived
outcome.isBlocked: boolean — true if any blocking defect or unmet certification gate
outcome.resolutionPath: string — human-readable recommendation for admin action

dataSourceMap.question: question_history.json + pack_*_corrected.js
dataSourceMap.history.sessions: question_history.json → resolved via session_registry.json for mode/title/series
dataSourceMap.history.recommendations: recommendation_registry.json (filtered by questionIds[] containing this QID)
dataSourceMap.investigations: investigation_registry.json (filtered by related_qids[] containing this QID)
dataSourceMap.outcome: Computed: currentState + healthTier + activeDefectFlags → synthesized verdict
